sections.heading: Bottom-up estimates
sections.detail: committed first — timestamp above, before any market number
sections.markdown:
Fundamentals only, from LK/statements: FY2025 NI IDR 1.196T (EPS 75.7) on revenue 76.6T, up from NI 1.033T (FY24) and 0.826T (FY23). H1-2026 NI 784B (+38% yoy, revenue +22%) — the delivery is live → FY2026E NI ~1.60T, EPS ~103. ROE 15.5%, gross margin 10.9%, net margin ~1.6%, book ~606/share, dividend 25/share maintained (~30% payout). Moat: largest device importer-distributor-retailer in Indonesia (distribution density = the method card's Indonesia-consumer variable); sustainable while distribution share and working-capital discipline hold.

- **Target 960** = 9.3x FY2026E EPS 103. Justified: 15.5% ROE, ~4% yield, dominant distribution share; implies ~1.6x book and ~10x EV/EBIT — a rational buyer pays that for >10% growth; still mid-cycle for a quality IDX retail-distribution franchise, not a no-fade DCF.
- **Kill 420** (−30%): falsification = the discovery move fully given back AND P/B ~0.69 — the market re-judged margins/working-capital as permanently impaired. Not a stop.
- **p_up 0.44** = registry rate for neglected_midcap_discovery (already prices most failures falling short); no upward deviation despite H1-2026 delivery because ERAA sits inside the macro AVOID (consumer-discretionary). p_down 0.56.
- **Carry**: net div yield 4.17% × 2.5y − 1.0% fee/tax drag. **Expected 19.0%** = 0.44×60 − 0.56×30 + 4.17×2.5 − 1.0.
- **Priors**: rate 0.44 held (no raise, no haircut). Up/|down| 2.0 vs library 1.83 — the kill is a falsification level, not a stop.

sections.heading: Priors disclosure
sections.detail: one sentence, from memory, written before document work
sections.markdown: My prior on the market narrative: ERAA is a low-margin handset distributor whose FY2025 cash-flow miss (CFO ~0.2x NI) marks the earnings as low-quality, and the +71% six-month run is a retail/short-covering pop in a consumer-discretionary name that the strengthened macro AVOID tilt will roll over as the delivered Fed hike and IDR ~17,912 squeeze Indonesian consumers.

sections.heading: Variant perception
sections.markdown:
**Market believes:** the run is a stocking/rotation artefact; thin ~1.6% net margin and collapsing cash conversion make this a value trap; when the AVOID binds, fair value is back near ~450-500.
**Why wrong:** (1) H1-2026 NI +38% yoy on revenue +22% is earnings, not inventory — the FY2025 cash drain was a Q4 stocking event (inventory +63%, OEM pipeline) that 2026 sell-through is validating. (2) The moat is distribution density — deepest GT/MT logistics reach of any Indonesian device distributor, a working-capital/volume franchise earning 15.5% ROE, not a duration-short discretionary story. (3) Neglect is live: ~9 sell-side names, mean target below spot, forward P/E 9.7 — the street does not yet believe durable growth is here. (4) The telecom/digital-id adjunct (SIM, top-up, VAS insurance/leasing attach) cushions retail flag weeks, but I do not claim it makes ERAA non-discretionary — hardware sell-through dominates the mix.
**What proves us wrong:** Q3-2026 LK (by 2026-10-31) shows CFO still 1.5× revenue; gross margin <10.3% under the IDR squeeze (pass-through failing); or price retraces below 500 — the AVOID won and the neglect was deserved.

sections.heading: Disconfirming facts
sections.detail: >=3, observable, current, each citing a filing line
sections.markdown:
1. FY2025 LK cash-flow: CFO +225B vs reported NI 1,196B (0.19x) with inventory +63% yoy (11.64T vs 7.13T) and receivables +31% vs revenue +17% (1.8x divergence flag tripped, though AR is ~2% of revenue). If FY2026 LTM conversion stays <0.4x at the Q3-2026 print, the seasonal-stocking story is false.
2. FY2025 gross margin 10.9%, H1-2026 10.7%. With IDR ~17,912 and USD-invoiced handset COGS, a print below ~10.3% means ERAA absorbs the FX squeeze instead of passing through — distributor economics break at scale.
3. Macro binding (the macro regime memo 2026-09-26): Fed hike delivered, carry narrowed to +162bp, IDR −1.7%. If BI hikes ≥50bp cumulatively by Q4-2026 and handset unit sell-through (not IDR revenue) declines, the credit-financed upgrade leg cracks — the screen fingerprints ERAA CONSUMER/domestic_cycle, so this is live, not tail.
4. 52w range 314-645: a close <420 (kill) means the re-rating is fully given back with washout-low retest risk; entry at spot ~600 with mom6 +71% has already used the chase allowance (max_chase_pct 3).

sections.heading: Pre-mortem
sections.markdown: It is early-2029 and this position lost ~30%. The most likely reason: the FY2025 cash-flow miss was NOT seasonal — inventory stayed high, FY2026-27 CFO stayed near zero, the earnings-quality flag was real; BI hiked to defend IDR into the delivered-hike carry sting, consumer installments cracked, unit sell-through fell, and the stock de-rated back below book — the macro AVOID worked and the momentum was a liquidity event that reversed. Competing failure: index candidacy never materialised and coverage never re-anchored — no discovery catalyst, neglect was deserved.

sections.heading: Judge verdict
sections.markdown:
**Verdict: PASS_REDUCED — 0.5× of the sizing engine recommended_pct.** The PM's `sizing.pm_pct` must respect 0.5×; deviations only downward.

Standing correction: this desk's record is 24 kills, 0 tickets, 0 deployment while benchmarks ran ~11%, and killed names averaged +7.0% above the kill price. I correct against the marginal-kill bias — a kill here spends a 60-day cooldown on a correctly-built thesis and buys cash at 5.50%.

1. **Process clean.** Lint passes; estimates committed before market data; draft→attack→revision→re-attack chain monotonic and verbatim; honest AVOID disclosure. The flagged up_pct raise 60→71 is ACCEPTED — mechanical arithmetic of the lower entry at a HELD target (960 = 9.3x FY26E EPS 103), flagged new evidence (560 = 7.4x stressed EPS 76). p_up held exactly at registry 0.44 — no deviation to rule against.
2. **Drew's re-attack survives on the merits.** The FX fragility is genuinely fixed AT the fill: 560 pre-pays the GM break (+26% at stressed EPS 76 vs 9.3x fair). The original construction defect — buying the falsification print at full momentum price — is cured: max_chase 0, spot never bought, 10-31 print gated.
3. **The scar is the sizing basis, not a kill.** The 26.7% is conditional-on-fill. p_fill is unmodeled and adversely selected (fills arrive with deepening IDR stress), and the 314-645 range shows the market has paid below 9.3x on stressed earnings — the honest stressed case is flat-to-kill, so unconditional EV is plausibly ~2× cash, attractive but not compelling. Hence 0.5×, not full size.
4. **No-fill costs nothing.** The limit order is a free option; the alternative is cash at 5.50%. The 10-31 gate makes this a discovery trade with a dated catalyst, not a pre-print gamble.
5. **Live flags bound the fraction**: CFO 0.19x NI (LK-attested, no dossier — print fronts it), 1.6% net margin, family control at 44% float, and the macro AVOID on consumer-discretionary under CAUTIOUS — the sleeve call is Voss/PM domain downstream and does not add to the haircut here.
